content.rendered: Our school and school offices will be closed for winter break December 19th – January 3rd. Students will return on Wednesday, January 4th. If you should need assistance during this time you can call our District Office at 503-825-5000. Wishing you all the best winter break and hope whatever you do it brings you happiness. Thank you all for making our school the best school to be a part of.  HERE is the last Middleton Principal Update for this year.  See you in 2023.
